description_en: Creates an application session, starts an application process, and returns the session information
description_zh: 创建应用会话，并启动一个应用进程，返回会话信息
name: CreateAppSession

parameters.help_en:
The application version ID.

If you do not specify an effective version, the default application uses the latest version
parameters.help_zh:
应用版本ID。

当您未指定生效版本时，默认应用最新版本
parameters.name: app_version

parameters.help_en:
The custom user ID. The maximum length is 64 characters.

This parameter is used for business operations at the user dimension. 

This parameter is required when the application type is `end_game` or `hand_game`
parameters.help_zh:
自定义用户ID，最大长度不超过64个字符。

用于业务对用户维度做相应的操作。 

当应用类型为`end_game`、`hand_game`时，本参数必填
parameters.name: custom_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom session ID. This parameter is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the parameter value from your client and ensure that the value is unique across different requests.

ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters
parameters.help_zh:
自定义会话ID，保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: custom_session_id

parameters.help_en: The client IP address of the service, such as the IP address of the player in a cloud gaming scenario
parameters.help_zh: 业务的客户端IP，比如云游戏场景中玩家的IP
parameters.name: client_ip

fields.help_en:
The supported enumeration values include:
startArgument: the application startup parameters
fields.help_zh:
目前支持的枚举值包括：
startArgument：应用启动参数
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value corresponding to the key
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The key value supports custom settings. The following reserved words are defined by convention:
utdid: the device ID, which helps the platform analyze the characteristics of unusual traffic and locate issues
fields.help_zh:
key取值支持自定义。约定以下保留字：
utdid：表示设备ID，可以帮助平台分析异常流量的特征和定位问题
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value corresponding to the key
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The system information, such as the client device model
parameters.help_zh: 系统信息，如客户端侧机型等信息
parameters.name: system_info

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for on-demand resource production in pay-as-you-go mode.
Valid values: 900 to 43200. Unit: seconds. Default value: 1800
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费模式按需生产资源的超时时间。
取值范围 [900, 43200]秒，默认值1800
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to produce resources on demand when creating a session in pay-as-you-go mode. Valid values:
true: yes
false: no. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费模式下创建会话时，是否按需生产资源。取值范围：
true：是
false：否，默认false
parameters.name: enable_postpaid

parameters.help_en: The project ID. If the application is associated with a project, you must specify the correct project ID when creating a session
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID。如果已将应用关联到项目，创建会话时需填写正确的项目ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The adapter file ID. This feature is available in canary release. Do not pass this parameter unless otherwise agreed
parameters.help_zh: 适配文件ID。此功能灰度开放，如未约定使用请勿传入
parameters.name: adapter_file_id

parameters.help_en:
The district ID. Valid values:

huadong

xinan

huanan

huabei

huazhong
parameters.help_zh:
区域ID。取值：

huadong

xinan

huanan

huabei

huazhong
parameters.name: district_id
